title: SmartAgri UGM and BOSCH Explore Collaboration on Smart Agricultural Research, Focusing on Oil Palm Plantation Challenges

body:
**Yogyakarta, May 27, 2025** – Smart Agriculture Research Center at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) and global technology giant BOSCH held an important meeting on Tuesday, May 27, 2025, to explore potential strategic research collaboration. This discussion indicates BOSCH's interest in precision agriculture in Indonesia, particularly in addressing complex challenges in oil palm plantations.

The meeting, which took place around 10:11 a.m., was attended by key representatives from both sides. From SmartAgri UGM, present were Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., and Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P. Meanwhile, BOSCH was represented by Pirmin Riegger and Gilrandy Respati.

The primary objective of the meeting was to identify potential areas where UGM's expertise in agriculture and BOSCH's technological innovation could synergize. BOSCH presented their capabilities and interests in agricultural technology, followed by a question-and-answer session and in-depth discussion. The main focus of the discussion centered on challenges in oil palm plantations, including Ganoderma issues, as well as obstacles in implementing and integrating agricultural technology.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/480-1-pasted-image-20250527101429-1030x575.webp)

BOSCH's presentation materials

During the discussion session, BOSCH specifically highlighted the need for further understanding regarding Ganoderma problems in oil palm plantations, challenges in field technology implementation, and strategies for managing agricultural product distribution. As a reference, an example was also mentioned of water quality monitoring in small and medium industries in Germany that could serve as inspiration.

As a follow-up, both parties agreed to hold further face-to-face meetings, either in Jakarta or at UGM, as well as establish a small working group to identify more concrete and focused collaborative research topics. This collaboration is expected to open the way for significant innovation in Indonesia's agricultural sector, particularly in addressing challenges in oil palm plantations through the application of smart technology.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 27 Mei 2025** – Smart Agriculture Research Center Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) dan raksasa teknologi global, BOSCH, mengadakan pertemuan penting pada Selasa, 27 Mei 2025, untuk menjajaki potensi kolaborasi riset strategis. Diskusi ini mengindikasikan ketertarikan BOSCH pada sektor pertanian presisi di Indonesia, khususnya dalam mengatasi tantangan kompleks di perkebunan kelapa sawit.

Pertemuan yang berlangsung sekitar pukul 10:11 pagi ini dihadiri oleh perwakilan kunci dari kedua belah pihak. Dari Smart Agriculture UGM, hadir Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng., Ardan Wiratmoko, S.T.P., M.Sc., dan Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, S.T.P. Sementara itu, BOSCH diwakili oleh Pirmin Riegger dan Gilrandy Respati.

Tujuan utama pertemuan ini adalah untuk mengidentifikasi area potensial di mana keahlian UGM dalam pertanian dan inovasi teknologi BOSCH dapat bersinergi. BOSCH mempresentasikan kapabilitas dan minat mereka dalam teknologi pertanian, yang kemudian dilanjutkan dengan sesi tanya jawab dan diskusi mendalam. Fokus utama diskusi mengarah pada tantangan di perkebunan kelapa sawit, termasuk isu Ganoderma, serta hambatan dalam penerapan dan pengintegrasian teknologi pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/480-1-pasted-image-20250527101429-1030x575.webp)

Pemaparan materi dari BOSCH

Dalam sesi diskusi, BOSCH secara khusus menyoroti kebutuhan untuk memahami lebih lanjut mengenai masalah Ganoderma pada perkebunan kelapa sawit, tantangan implementasi teknologi di lapangan, dan strategi manajemen distribusi produk pertanian. Sebagai referensi, disebutkan pula contoh monitoring kualitas air pada industri kecil menengah di Jerman yang dapat menjadi inspirasi.

Sebagai tindak lanjut, kedua belah pihak sepakat untuk mengadakan pertemuan tatap muka lebih lanjut, baik di Jakarta maupun di UGM, serta membentuk kelompok kerja kecil (small working group) untuk mengidentifikasi topik riset kolaborasi yang lebih konkret dan terarah. Kolaborasi ini diharapkan dapat membuka jalan bagi inovasi signifikan dalam sektor pertanian Indonesia, khususnya dalam menghadapi tantangan di perkebunan kelapa sawit melalui penerapan teknologi cerdas.
